column1: # AQL Language Specification: generic types — schemas + instantiation
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# `def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T]` declares a generic SCHEMA:
# `gen [...]` declares the type parameters (binding placeholder types
# for the constructor body and parking the spec for the next type
# constructor), `refine Record` / `fnsig` builds the body with the
# placeholders live, and `def` installs the schema. `Box of [Integer]`
# instantiates: arity-checks (defaults fill), constraint-checks each
# argument against its `extends` bound (Is-membership — lattice bounds,
# predicates, disjuncts, negations, and surfaces all answer uniformly),
# and memoises ONE instantiation per (schema, canonical args).
# Recursion uses `Self of [T]` (the schema's own name is unbound while
# its body builds). See design/GENERICS.0.md.
# §1  record schemas — declare + instantiate
def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end Box
column3: a schema renders with its parameter list

column1: def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end Box of [Integer]
column3: instantiation substitutes the parameter

column1: def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end Box of [String]
column3: …independently per argument

column1: def Pair gen [K V] refine Record [key:K value:V] end Pair of [String Integer]
column3: two parameters substitute positionally

column1: def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end (Box of [Integer]) teq (Box of [Integer])
column3: instantiations are memoised — one identity per (schema, args)

column1: def Stack gen [T] refine Record [items:[:T]] end Stack of [Integer]
column3: a typed-list child constraint substitutes

column1: def Wrap gen [T] refine Record [tags:{:T}] end Wrap of [String]
column3: a typed-map child constraint substitutes

column1: # §2  fn-shape schemas
def Mapper gen [T U] fnsig [[T] [U]] end (Mapper of [Integer String]) typeof
column3: a generic fn shape instantiates to a concrete FunctionSignature

column1: def Mapper gen [T U] fnsig [[T] [U]] end (Mapper of [Integer String]) teq (Mapper of [Integer String])
column3: fn-shape instantiations memoise too

column1: # §3  bounds (extends) — Is-membership, uniformly
def Sorted gen [(T extends Number)] refine Record [items:[:T]] end Sorted of [Integer]
column3: a lattice bound admits a subtype

column1: def Sorted gen [(T extends Number)] refine Record [items:[:T]] end Sorted of [String]
column3: …and rejects a non-member loudly

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} def area fn [[c:Circle] [Float] [1.0]] Circle exposes Shape def Holder gen [(T extends Shape)] refine Record [item:T] end Holder of [Circle]
column3: a SURFACE bound admits an exposer (S4: same membership machinery)

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Holder gen [(T extends Shape)] refine Record [item:T] end Holder of [Integer]
column3: …and rejects a non-exposer

column1: def Pos (Integer gt 0) def H gen [(T extends Pos)] refine Record [x:T] end H of [Pos]
column3: a predicate-refinement bound admits itself

column1: # §4  defaults — lazy, may reference earlier parameters
def Result gen [T (E default Error)] refine Record [ok:T err:E] end Result of [Integer]
column3: a defaulted parameter fills when omitted

column1: def Result gen [T (E default Error)] refine Record [ok:T err:E] end Result of [Integer String]
column3: …and is overridable

column1: def P gen [T (U default T)] refine Record [a:T b:U] end P of [Integer]
column3: a default may reference an earlier parameter (lazy)

column1: # §5  recursion — Self of [...]
def Tree gen [T] refine Record [value:T left:(Self of [T])] end Tree of [Integer]
column3: Self ties the recursive knot to the in-flight instantiation

column1: # §6  negatives — loud at the right site
def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end Box of [Integer String]
column3: too many type arguments

column1: def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] end Box of []
column3: too few without defaults — the missing parameter is named

column1: gen [t] refine Record [x:Integer]
column3: parameters follow the type-name convention

column1: gen [T T] refine Record [x:Integer]
column3: duplicate parameter names are rejected

column1: gen [T]
column3: an orphan gen (no constructor consumed it) is loud

column1: gen [T] gen [U] refine Record [x:Integer]
column3: two gens with no constructor between them

column3: of requires a schema head

column1: def NotGen refine Record [x:Integer] end NotGen of [Integer]
column3: a plain record is not instantiable

column1: # §7  integration — typed defs, fn params, modules, shadowing
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end def b:(Box of [Integer]) {value:42} b typeof
column3: a parenthesised annotation evaluates — typed def constructs the instance

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end def b:(Box of [Integer]) {value:'no'}
column3: …with the substituted field typing enforced

column1: def Pair gen [K V] refine Record [key:K value:V] end make (Pair of [String Integer]) {key:'a' value:1}
column3: records construct through make

column1: def Pair gen [K V] refine Record [key:K value:V] end make (Pair of [String Integer]) {key:1 value:1}
column3: …with record make's existing convert-to-field-type contract (strictness is the CLASS contract)

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} def f fn [[x:(Box of [Integer])] [Integer] [x get value]] end f (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:7})
column3: an instantiation-typed fn param dispatches

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} def f fn [[x:(Box of [Integer])] [Integer] [x get value]] end f (make (Box of [String]) {value:'s'})
column3: …and REJECTS a sibling instantiation (no silent Any degrade)

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} def g fn [[x:Box] [Integer] [1]] end g (make (Box of [String]) {value:'s'})
column3: a bare-schema param admits any instantiation (family membership)

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} def g fn [[x:Box] [Integer] [1]] end g 5
column3: …and rejects non-members

column1: module [def Box gen [T] refine Record [value:T] export "Pkg" {Box: Box}] import end Pkg.Box of [Integer]
column3: a module exports a schema; importer-side of instantiates

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} def Box Integer end Box of [Integer]
